integrity: Complete binary-mask enumeration and independent direct divisor-pair subset-sum dynamic programming are included, both using deterministic primality sieving and exact integers.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact first-branching result for numbers of form 2^a p with p odd prime; no classification of a>9 or infinite multiplicity. Full text of arXiv:2609.36068 was inaccessible; novelty assessment explicitly records this residual risk.
title: First branching of odd-prime completions for strongly pseudoperfect binary supports
